title: Topological Kuramoto model on cell complexes: implementation

creators.name: Bačić, Iva
creators.affiliation: Forschungszentrum Jülich, Institute for Climate and Energy Systems (ICE-1)

description: Reference implementation for the topological Kuramoto model studied in "Phase locking and multistability in the topological Kuramoto model on cell complexes". The code provides routines for constructing oriented cell and simplicial complexes (including the five Platonic solids and ring topologies), assembling the associated boundary operators, solving the topological nonlinear Kirchhoff conditions, enumerating phase-locked solutions indexed by winding numbers, checking their linear stability via the Jacobian spectrum, and reproducing all figures in the manuscript.
